releases.summary: Patch release for exercising the Doki stable updater flow.
changes: Bumps Doki to 1.2.1 so installations on 1.2.0 can perform a real stable-tag update.
Keeps database schema unchanged at version 17.
operatorNotes: Use this release to verify check, migration dry-run, backup, checkout, and restart stages from the Updates page.
No destructive changes are declared for this release.

releases.summary: Adds the Doki Updates admin surface and host-side stable release updater.
changes: Adds a super-admin Doki Updates page that opens the update helper with a short-lived token.
Adds a localhost-only update-helper service for stable tag checks, Doki health, migration dry-runs, and apply progress.
Restricts updater discovery to stable semantic version tags such as v1.2.0.
Blocks updates when managed files have local changes.
Runs migration dry-runs against a copied SQLite database before applying updates.
Creates a live database backup before applying an update.
Keeps updater token/state files and SQLite WAL sidecars out of source control.
operatorNotes: Only super-admins can open the Doki Updates page.
The update-helper service is exposed on 127.0.0.1:8100 by default.
This release adds a new Compose service, so rebuild/restart the stack after installing it.
No destructive changes are declared for this release.

releases.summary: Adds the Logger core app and improves first-run setup/start ergonomics.

databaseMigrations.summary: Logger app creates its own tables on first use.

changes: Adds Logger as a core installed app for viewing configured log files across Doki targets.
Runs setup inside the php-app container so host PHP extensions no longer block setup.
Improves start.sh and setup.sh Docker/Compose checks and startup guidance.
Refreshes README setup order to start Doki before running setup.
operatorNotes: Run ./setup.sh after ./start.sh to refresh runtime state and health checks.
No destructive changes are declared for this release.

releases.summary: Initial Doki release baseline from main.
changes: Establishes the first release baseline for Doki updates.
Includes Doki admin, apps, workflows, sources, onboarding, and schema version 17.
operatorNotes: Installs without release metadata should be treated as 1.0.0 by the updater.
